purpose: Track mainstream benchmarks and baselines that GuardX uses for comparison, safe-abstraction mapping, or future official-subset evaluation.
raw_payload_policy: Do not commit raw high-risk prompts unless license and safety review pass. Prefer metadata-only or safe-abstraction cases in this repository.

benchmarks.name: JailbreakBench
benchmarks.current_status: safe-abstraction subset connected to semantic matrix
benchmarks.next_step: License-review official prompts and run a small external heldout subset without storing raw high-risk text in reports.

benchmarks.name: HarmBench
benchmarks.current_status: safe-abstraction subset connected to semantic matrix
benchmarks.next_step: Run licensed behavior categories as route-level tests and compare output guard refusal behavior.

benchmarks.name: XSTest
benchmarks.guardx_mapping: OFF-XS benign safety education and refusal-boundary cases
benchmarks.current_status: safe-abstraction subset connected to semantic matrix and false-positive probe
benchmarks.next_step: Expand benign security-education cases so GuardX does not over-block defensive learning.

benchmarks.name: StrongREJECT
benchmarks.current_status: safe-abstraction subset connected to semantic matrix
benchmarks.next_step: Use LLM-as-judge only for aggregate evaluation, with raw prompts excluded from repository artifacts.

benchmarks.name: AgentDojo
benchmarks.guardx_mapping: OFF-AI RAG, tool output, plugin, and tool-sequence cases
benchmarks.current_status: safe-abstraction subset connected to semantic matrix; replay/evidence chain available
benchmarks.next_step: Map a small Inspect/AgentDojo-compatible task into executor lifecycle replay.

benchmarks.name: InjecAgent
benchmarks.guardx_mapping: OFF-AI indirect data exfiltration, sensitive file, network export, OCR hidden instruction cases
benchmarks.current_status: safe-abstraction subset connected to semantic matrix
benchmarks.next_step: Add tool/user-tool separation metadata to provenance and executor replay reports.
